description: Runs a fee-aware walk-forward test of a long-only SMA crossover strategy on up to ~900 days of daily data for a major crypto asset (re-optimized on 180 days, tested on the next 60) and returns out-of-sample return vs buy-and-hold, per-fold results and a pass/fail verdict.

fee_bps.description: Trading fee per side in basis points (0-100). Default 10.

symbol.description: Crypto ticker quoted in USD on Coinbase, e.g. BTC, ETH, SOL

name: walkforward_backtest_summary
title: Walk-Forward Trend Backtest Summary
